Thank you for coming,
<name job> <name hero>.

As you know, there are
hostile machines down
in the mines on Ragol.

We've found a large
concentration of them in
one area.

The council has decided
that something must be
done, and has ordered

the annihilation of this
contingent of machines.

I would like you to
take care of this!

It is surely dangerous,
but I know you won't
let me down.

As always, Irene can give
you the details of this
mission.
I'm counting on you.

Please speak to Irene,
my secretary.
Rico...!
N...no, it's nothing.

Please, hurry up and
destroy those machines.
Thank you very much.

You did exactly what I've
come to expect from you.

If left unchecked, those
machines could have posed
a huge threat to us.

I may call upon you
again, <name hero>.

Until then, continue to
hone your excellent
skills.

Continue to train
yourself until new orders
come in.

Where do you think you're
going?

You haven't spoken with
Irene for the details of
this mission, yet!

Here are the details
for the current mission.

Destroy a group of
machines that have
gathered in the mines.

A teleporter has already
been set up to take you
there.

You can get to the mine
area directly from the
city.

I have a feeling that
this will be a very
intense battle.

Make sure that you're
well enough prepared
for it.
Be careful.
And good luck.
